unchanged_contracts: All original token_tests.rs bytes remain a complete prefix; no existing assertion, read/write operation or impersonation sequence changed.

physical_controls.fixtures: Two separately created matrices per test, four rows per matrix, one regular file and one empty directory per row; every matrix parent/target owns an exact retained handle.
physical_controls.permissions: Protected DACL, original ACL argument NULL, explicit Everyone allow plus route-specific explicit deny, no inheritance. Parent and target rights set separately. Host and restricted matrices compare actual DACL bytes before any operation.
physical_controls.handles: FILE_GENERIC_READ|WRITE_DAC only, no DELETE; share READ|WRITE|DELETE; assert HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT absent. Retained handles are never passed to the child.
physical_controls.observation: After RevertToSelf or child completion: exact retained volume/file ID, unchanged actual DACL, original file contents, FileStandardInfo pending/link fields. Then release handles and require either same path identity or true NotFound; all other readback errors fail.
physical_controls.delete_pending: Pending/link state is observed, not hard-coded as a universal success shape. Last-close deletion and POSIX unlink are both resolved by post-release physical path state.
physical_controls.host_native_oracle: All eight operations attempted; Neither returns PermissionDenied/rawOS5 for file and directory; remaining six return success. Physical outcomes must match [false,true,true,true] for both object kinds.
physical_controls.host_cmd_oracle: Real ordinary cmd, all four ordered attempt markers and exactly one done marker; process exit0; physical outcomes must match [false,true,true,true]. Raw cmd ERRORLEVEL is logged but is not represented as a Win32 errno.
physical_controls.direct_token_oracle: Unchanged capability-only constructor with two active SIDs; selected membership verifies capA/capB true, logon/Everyone false. Allowed-root deletes and outside reads succeed before frozen all-eight PermissionDenied/rawOS5 and no-delete endpoint.
physical_controls.legacy_oracle: Unchanged workspace_write profile and real legacy spawn with permitted workspace/TEMP/TMP; permitted object deletion succeeds, full attempt/done markers appear, every outside target remains.
physical_controls.cleanup: Normal retained-handle original-DACL restoration propagates errors unless object is already pending/unlinked; exceptional Drop only makes best-effort same-object cleanup, never an acceptance result.

causal_acceptance.baseline_required: Host matrix, actual native DACL/identity checks, allowed-capability positive and complete restricted endpoint must be observed on the exact Windows source. Setup/compile/error-path/timeouts or selected-zero are insufficient.
causal_acceptance.target_route_finding: If the verified TargetOnly restricted object actually disappears, ordinary target DELETE is an observed admission route despite the missing matching capability; do not infer this before execution.
causal_acceptance.parent_route_finding: If the verified ParentOnly restricted object actually disappears, ordinary parent DELETE_CHILD is an observed admission route despite the missing matching capability; do not infer this before execution.
causal_acceptance.combination: Both is a separate physical cell; neither host mismatch nor only a Both result can isolate the two routes.
causal_acceptance.frozen_pass_endpoint: Both new selected tests must pass their full strict host and restricted physical assertions. On the unchanged current product they may instead expose genuine failures; such failures are retained.
does_not_prove: WRITE_RESTRICTED is the unique kernel cause or a replacement token policy is safe.
